newLayers.name: Sorting and Collections
newLayers.description: Data structures and sorters used for shuffle and aggregation: bit sets, compact buffers, the spillable external append-only map, TimSort, radix sort, prefix comparators and the unsafe sorter spill writer, reader and mergers.

appendDesc.Core Utilities: Also covers SizeEstimator (object size estimation), ThreadUtils and UninterruptibleThread, StatCounter, the uncaught exception handler and exit codes, the stub class loader and task completion listeners.

tour.title: Spilling sorters: UnsafeExternalSorter and its spill files
tour.description: When records no longer fit in memory, UnsafeExternalSorter hands sorted runs to UnsafeSorterSpillWriter. UnsafeSorterSpillReader reads a run back, and UnsafeSorterSpillMerger with UnsafeSorterBoundedSpillMerger merge the runs through the UnsafeSorterIterator interface. PrefixComparators and RadixSort speed up the in-memory sort.
